findings.message: Prose has outgrown the links. A capability is a hub — move the detail into the documents it should be pointing at, and link to them from here.
This is longer than a capture should be. If it needs this much explaining it has outgrown the tier — promote it rather than expanding it here.
Prose has outgrown the links. Each fact restated here is a second copy to keep true — link to the document that owns it instead.
`detected-on` is before `occurred-on` — an incident cannot be found before it began. If the dates are right, the earlier one is when it started.
Symptoms must be the first section. Someone reaching for this at 2am matches on what they are seeing, not on what the document is called.
A standard cites where its authority comes from — an ADR in `derived-from`, a policy in `implements`, or both. With neither this is guidance, and guidance is an explanation.
